user.title: Borochi hybrid inverter (Modbus RTU)
user.description: Connect a USB-RS485 adapter to the inverter's COM connector (pin 7 = A, pin 8 = B). The port must not be used by another Modbus configuration. This integration is a beta and read-only.

data_description.port: Preferably use the stable path under /dev/serial/by-id/.
data_description.slave: Factory default of the inverter is 1.

error.cannot_connect: No response. Port in use? Check address, baud rate and A/B wiring.
error.unknown_device: The device responds but is not a recognised Borochi inverter.
